decisions.reason: The generic definition is circular and the acrobatic noun does not verify the intended descending adjective or uncontrolled-fall meaning.
Pathological swelling or tumor formation is not an appropriate alternative for the sole Fitness muscular-hypertrophy anchor.
Fluid-related swelling is a different process from exercise hypertrophy; the only Fitness anchor does not justify the proposed substitution.
Depravity or wickedness directly verifies the moral vice meaning without supplying jurisdiction-specific legal conclusions.
A student of a tutor is explicitly defined; the source does not require teaching to be strictly one-to-one.
The year meaning is directly sourced; retain dated usage rather than presenting it as a routine formal substitute.
A beginner or novice is explicitly sourced and fits learning a new activity, without inventing register restrictions.
The thin lightweight portable computer is directly described; no guarantee of high performance or premium pricing is inferred.
The medium-to-dark brown color directly supports the color anchor, separate from clay pigment and animal homonyms.
Unexpectedly is explicitly supplied alongside lack of anticipation; retain non-comparable usage without claiming nobody could foresee the event.
The source explicitly explains without stopping and continuously, avoiding the different resolve-focused WordNet candidate.
The armpit noun directly matches the body-part anchor; retain often attributive usage and exclude cricket and weaponry senses.
No exact plural source mapping was recovered; the proposed critical register and lower-rank meaning remain unverified for this identity.
The deputy sheriff or second-in-command definition is explicitly jurisdiction-qualified; that qualification is retained instead of universalizing the rank.
The underneath surface, bottom or underside is directly explained without adding a technical-only register requirement.
The source only repeats underwritten financially and does not explain risk acceptance, securities issuance or insurance sufficiently to verify the intended sense.
A wave-like curve and regular rise and fall directly verifies the motion-pattern meaning, avoiding dubious air/radiation or dated medical candidates.
The sole candidate repeats universalizing without explaining the proposed spread-to-everyone meaning or distinction from globalization.
Facing facts realistically and with determination supplies an informative source meaning for toughness without equating it with cruelty or total lack of feeling.
Without the sense of sight directly verifies the adjective; do not add the unsupported recommendation to label people collectively as the unsighted.
Undoing woven material is verified but lacks a relevant Fitness learning context beyond the ambiguous unravel anchor.
The concatenated expression has no exact source identity evidence; a guessed spacing repair cannot establish publication.
No exact sense was recovered and the Business capitalization anchor could concern finance rather than letter case.
Indecision in speech or action directly supports hesitation, separate from physical back-and-forth movement.
Adding variety is explicitly sourced for the diversify anchor; color marking is not imposed on every use.
The named-grape wine definition is explicit and allows primarily rather than exclusively one variety, avoiding an overly strict purity claim.
The vegan activist meaning is explained with animal-rights campaigning; retain rare status and do not equate activism with stricter dietary adherence.
A vessel carrying blood toward the heart is explicitly explained and fits anatomical vein vocabulary without restricting it to major veins.
Being for sale in relation to bribery or corruption directly supports the intended corruptibility meaning.
The person to whom something is sold is plainly defined and matches purchaser without an unsupported real-estate-only restriction.
Persons summoned for jury selection are explicitly described; retain US usage and distinguish the pool from the final selected jury.
Involving pulmonary ventilation is directly sourced for respiratory vocabulary without requiring artificial breathing machinery.
Truly and accurately describing something independently explains the adverb instead of relying only on veritable.
Only the red-color adjective is verified, not the intended anatomical noun for the lip region; keep the spelling and sense mapping unresolved.
Malicious defamation or character assassination is explicitly explained; sustained duration and publicity are not required beyond the source.
The historical bowed-string family is directly defined as related to but distinct from violins, without treating the instruments as synonyms.
The bluish-green color is directly sourced without needing the pigment-chemistry alternative to explain ordinary color use.
A complete viral particle precisely verifies the physical entity and avoids the potentially misleading viral-equivalent-of-a-cell analogy.
The internal-organ meaning is fully explained with abdominal emphasis and plural usage; exclude unrelated Business organizational senses of organ.
A guest or visitor is directly supplied by the source; ghosts, migratory birds and invented stranger connotations are not selected.
